# Minecraft Player Style Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, fun Minecraft quiz in chat. It asks ten original questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, then names one player style, builder, explorer, miner, farmer or fighter, with a biome to try that fits that style. It is just for fun, not a personality test, and not a guide, download or purchase.

It is a fan quiz, unofficial, not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. No official image, text, music or logo is copied. No download, purchase or mod instruction is given.
